info.description: Explicit HTTP trading instructions for one verified demo account. OpenAPI is the interface source of truth; docs/api-contract.md explains operational guarantees. No real-money accounts. Query and execution credentials are independent. Never embed either key in a public frontend.

get.summary: Historical broker OHLC candles with tick volume
get.description: Read-only. Prices and tick volumes are decimal strings. Candles are sorted by opening time; gaps are not filled and the current bar may be incomplete. Use nextTo to page backwards with the same from and period. brokerHasMore preserves provider information; mayHaveMore is conservative when the count limit is reached.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds; nonnegative. Maximum window 3660 days. Default lookback depends on period and limit, with at least seven days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds; defaults to now, cannot be in the future or exceed 2147483646000.

200.description: Successful response

get.description: Latest JSON state and version for the account and agent ID. IDs are logical namespaces, not access-control boundaries. Returns 404 until first save. Does not call the broker.

200.description: Successful response

put.summary: Save caller-defined agent state using optimistic concurrency
put.description: Database write only; works with TRADING_ENABLED=false. expectedVersion=0 creates a state, otherwise the current version must match. Stale versions return 409; read and reconcile instead of overwriting. No trading rules, budget reservations or broker actions are inferred from state.

200.description: Successful response

symbol.description: Exact enabled broker catalog name, including case, suffixes and internal spaces. No control characters or surrounding whitespace. ALLOWED_SYMBOLS=* enables the full catalog, but * is not a valid order symbol.

stopLossPips.description: Positive pips, up to two decimals; broker precision and configured maximum also apply.

takeProfitPips.description: Positive pips, up to two decimals.

allowedSymbols.description: ["*"] admits every enabled instrument in this demo broker catalog; an explicit list remains restrictive.

limitsBySymbol.description: Effective filters for an explicit allowlist; in wildcard mode, only explicitly overridden names. Actual order previews return their effective limits.

fixedNotionalUsd.description: No fixed USD allocation or notional cap is imposed. Broker and configured volume, margin and position limits still apply.

maxOpenPositions.description: Account-wide API position-count limit. 0 disables this count limit; margin, volume and broker restrictions still apply.

positionLimitEnabled.description: True when maxOpenPositions is a positive configured limit.

open.description: Exact price using five decimal places.

high.description: Exact price using five decimal places.

low.description: Exact price using five decimal places.

close.description: Exact price using five decimal places.

tickVolume.description: Number of ticks, not instrument units or money.

state.description: Caller-defined JSON checkpoint; whole HTTP body is limited to 8 KiB. Store context, intent and risk data; no secrets.

Error403.description: Insufficient scope, disabled trading or forbidden origin

Error429.description: Account busy or request rate limited

Error502.description: Broker authentication, transport or verification failed

Error409.description: Conflicting idempotency key or unresolved operation
